load_fastai_model: load a pretrained fastai Learner model from a Hugging Face Hub repo or local directory
push_fastai_model: push a fastai Learner model to a Hugging Face Hub repository with optional config and file filtering
save_fastai_model: save a fastai Learner to a local directory as a pickle file with model card and pyproject.toml
create_model_card: create a README.md model card template in a repository directory for a fastai model
create_model_pyproject: create a pyproject.toml file with fastai and fastcore version requirements in a repository directory
